description: Karta nevarnosti zaradi poplav (KNP) - predhodna in poplavna območja is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by evode.arso.gov.si. The layer shows the flood hazard map, including preliminary flood hazard and flood hazard areas in the territory of the Republic of Slovenia. Coverage: SI. The portal shows the English title as "Flood Hazard Map - Preliminary and Flood Hazard Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include poplave, flood hazard, floods, poplavna nevarnost. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
